sourceObservations: StageResultWrites is installed only as write in the isolated selected Consumer namespace, after the separate original host-function namespace is loaded. Original shared.write/write_bytes, Consumer AST bodies and other module writers are unchanged.

Its three literal paths equal the real Consumer root paths because shared.Commands is constructed with cwd=output and Consumer(root=output). The selected paths are focus-lifecycle/focus-lifecycle/result.json, editor/preparation/result.json and editor/ui/result.json under output/evidence/lanes. No wildcard or unrelated artifact is selected.

For an actual original FAIL result object, the writer snapshots its existing firstFailure or first qualification error before invoking the original exclusive writer. It never synthesizes a successful result, swallows the original IO exception, rewrites the receipt or modifies validator output.

The first retained cause is immutable in the adapter. Later result IO errors are recorded separately and rethrown. execute_lane prefers that actual original cause, then the original command cause, then the escaping exception, with secondary IO observations retained explicitly.

The same object can serve all three selected stages because the original controller stops before a later lane on any lane/checkpoint failure; a failed preparation also prevents that lane's UI. There is no continued successful-lane replay after a retained prior failure.
If no original failure precedes the write, the IO error remains the first failure. A successful original stage receipt cannot become success in the outer lane after a write exception.

The correction introduces only file/object observation. It neither spawns commands nor changes owned-process closure, cancellation, source/query admission, device operations, resource floors, deadlines, method selections, screenshots, fixture or visual-pending boundaries.
